originalTitle: Dow Inc. (DOW) Stock Sinks As Market Gains: Here's Why
summary: Dow Inc. (DOW) concluded the recent trading session at $29.03, signifying a -2.06% move from its prior day's close.
content:
Dow Inc. (DOW) closed the most recent trading day at $29.03, moving -2.06% from the previous trading session. The stock trailed the S&P 500, which registered a daily gain of 0.86%. Elsewhere, the Dow saw an upswing of 0.98%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq appreciated by 0.96%.

Shares of the materials science witnessed a loss of 2.37% over the previous month, trailing the performance of the Basic Materials sector with its loss of 0.74%, and the S&P 500's loss of 1.96%.

Market participants will be closely following the financial results of Dow Inc. in its upcoming release. The company is predicted to post an EPS of $0.78, indicating a 510.53% growth compared to the equivalent quarter last year. Meanwhile, the latest consensus estimate predicts the revenue to be $11.22 billion, indicating a 12.52% increase compared to the same quarter of the previous year.

For the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates project earnings of $2.42 per share and a revenue of $43.31 billion, demonstrating changes of +357.45% and +8.37%, respectively, from the preceding year.

Any recent changes to analyst estimates for Dow Inc. should also be noted by investors. These latest adjustments often mirror the shifting dynamics of short-term business patterns. Hence, positive alterations in estimates signify analyst optimism regarding the business and profitability.

Our research suggests that these changes in estimates have a direct relationship with upcoming stock price performance. To utilize this, we have created the Zacks Rank, a proprietary model that integrates these estimate changes and provides a functional rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which ranges from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), has an impressive outside-audited track record of outperformance, with #1 stocks generating an average annual return of +25% since 1988. The Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 3.59% lower within the past month. Dow Inc. is holding a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold) right now.

With respect to valuation, Dow Inc. is currently being traded at a Forward P/E ratio of 12.26. This denotes a discount relative to the industry average Forward P/E of 17.

It's also important to note that DOW currently trades at a PEG ratio of 0.38. This popular metric is similar to the widely-known P/E ratio, with the difference being that the PEG ratio also takes into account the company's expected earnings growth rate. The Chemical - Diversified was holding an average PEG ratio of 1.19 at yesterday's closing price.

The Chemical - Diversified industry is part of the Basic Materials sector. With its current Zacks Industry Rank of 95, this industry ranks in the top 39% of all industries, numbering over 250.

The Zacks Industry Rank is ordered from best to worst in terms of the average Zacks Rank of the individual companies within each of these sectors. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 陶氏化学公司 (DOW) 股票随着市场上涨而下跌：原因如下
chineseSummary: 陶氏化学公司 (DOW) 最近交易日收盘价为 29.03 美元，较前一交易日收盘价上涨 -2.06%。
chineseContent:
陶氏化学公司 (DOW) 最近一个交易日收于 29.03 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -2.06%。该股落后于标准普尔 500 指数，后者日涨幅为 0.86%。其他方面，道指上涨 0.98%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数则上涨 0.96%。

材料科学股较上月下跌 2.37%，落后于基础材料板块的跌幅 0.74%，以及标准普尔 500 指数的跌幅 1.96%。

市场参与者将密切关注陶氏公司即将发布的财务业绩。该公司预计每股收益为 0.78 美元，较去年同期增长 510.53%。与此同时，最新的共识预测收入为112.2亿美元，较去年同期增长12.52%。

Zacks 一致估计全年每股收益为 2.42 美元，营收为 433.1 亿美元，较上年分别变化 +357.45% 和 +8.37%。

投资者还应注意陶氏化学公司分析师预测的任何近期变化。这些最新的调整通常反映了短期业务模式的动态变化。因此，预测的积极变化表明分析师对业务和盈利能力持乐观态度。

我们的研究表明，这些预估变化与即将到来的股价表现有直接关系。为了利用这一点，我们创建了 Zacks Rank，这是一个集成了这些估计变化并提供功能评级系统的专有模型。

Zacks Rank 系统的范围从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），具有令人印象深刻的外部审计表现优异记录，自 1988 年以来#1 股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。Zacks 共识 EPS 估计在过去一个月内下降了 3.59%。陶氏公司目前的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

就估值而言，陶氏化学公司目前的远期市盈率为 12.26。这表示相对于行业平均远期市盈率 17 的折扣。

还需要注意的是，道琼斯指数目前的 PEG 比率为 0.38。这个流行的指标与广为人知的市盈率类似，不同之处在于，PEG比率还考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天收盘价，多元化化学公司的平均 PEG 率为 1.19。

化学 - 多元化工业是基础材料行业的一部分。目前该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 95 位，在所有行业中排名前 39%，数量超过 250 个。

Zacks 行业排名是根据每个行业内各个公司的平均 Zacks 排名从最好到最差排序的。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
